messages:
dmitri_oncall: FYI — we saw a burst of duplicate pagers between 03:10-03:22 UTC. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/pm-2230-pager-noise. Need a follow-up on backpressure/silence windows and dedupe ownership.

alice.dev: Looking. I skimmed the PM — looks like the burst came from 3 sources firing the same alert when the cache warmed. I can own dedupe implementation (short term).

ben_sre: Can you paste the rule that caused the duplicates? want to check fanout + eval_period.

dmitri_oncall: Here's the rule we have in prod (sanitized):
```yaml
alert: HighRequestLatency
expr: job:request_latency_seconds:mean5m > 0.75
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: infra
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/latency
```
The issue was two separate exporters emitting slightly different series labels (region + az) so dedupe didn't kick.

ben_sre: Got it. Two quick ideas: 1) normalize labels at scrape time (drop az when not needed) 2) implement backpressure: once pager fires for an alert fingerprint, silence identical fingerprints for Xm with automatic decay.

carla_pm: Timeline question — how fast can we get a mitigation into prod? We need an SLA with customers on paging reduction work. Recommend short-term quick fix + medium-term plan.

alice.dev: Short-term: label normalization + a 5m suppression window should eliminate the storm. I can open a PR today for the prometheus relabel_config and a companion rule in the alertmanager to apply a 5m mute on matching fingerprints. Medium-term: a dedupe service or router that collapses identical alerts across regions before paging.

ben_sre: +1. Also propose a playbook entry: "pager backpressure" with steps: detect storm (X pages in Y mins), auto-suppress for candidate fingerprints, notify channel with details and link to PM. We should include a manual override.

incident-bot: Incident 2230-pager-noise created. Assigned owners: alice.dev (label normalizer), ben_sre (backpressure playbook), carla_pm (stakeholder comms). Due: 2024-05-07.

carla_pm: Thanks. For coms: I'll prepare a short note to affected product teams and schedule a 1:1 with infra owners. Target rollout: label changes + suppression test in staging by EOD tomorrow, prod rollout after safety window on Friday.

alice.dev: Plan for staging test: relabel_config change + unit test and end-to-end smoke that triggers the alert with synthetic metrics. I'll include the exact test steps in the PR.

ben_sre: For the backpressure implementation I'll sketch a stateful dedupe helper that tracks active fingerprints in redis with TTL and exposes an API for Alertmanager webhook to check/suppress. Will draft design doc and propose a canary on a non-critical alert.

carla_pm: Action items (as discussed):
- alice.dev: PR for relabel_config + suppression rule (due 2024-04-30)
- ben_sre: Draft backpressure playbook + design doc (due 2024-05-07)
- dmitri_oncall: Runbook update + paging metrics dashboard (due 2024-05-02)
- carla_pm: Stakeholder comms + rollout calendar (due 2024-05-01)

alice.dev: I'll add a small smoke job: send synthetic metric with different az labels and verify single pager fired. Also will include how to rollback.

ben_sre: One more thought — ensure we don't accidentally mute distinct causes. Playbook must include a checklist: verify metric fingerprint hash differs only by az label and that other labels (cluster, app) match.

dmitri_oncall: Sounds good. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to walk through the tests and acceptance criteria.

carla_pm: If anyone wants to swap ownership, speak up now. Otherwise we'll stick to assignments above.

alice.dev: sticking w/ it.

ben_sre: will own the playbook.

incident-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 2024-05-08 09:00 UTC.

dmitri_oncall: Thanks everyone. We'll aim to reduce duplicate pages by >90% with these mitigations.

carla_pm: closing with a note — please add any further subtasks to the incident ticket so we can track in the postmortem dashboard. :memo:
